page.title: About
page.description: Installed version, branch state and update

installed.title: Installed
installed.branch_mismatch: branch {branch} is checked out in the working directory

upstream.title: Available on branch {branch}
upstream.ahead: ahead by {n}: the update won't be able to fast-forward the branch
upstream.up_to_date: the installation is on the latest commit of the branch

refusal.dirty_tree: The working directory has uncommitted changes — the update will refuse to run
refusal.branch_mismatch: The wrong branch is checked out — the update fast-forwards its own branch, it doesn't move the installation to another one
refusal.platform_unsupported: Updating from the app doesn't work on Windows — update the installation manually (see README)

update.title: Update
update.description: Runs update.sh: stops the processes, fast-forwards the branch, syncs dependencies, copies the database, runs migrations and starts everything again.
update.confirm_text: The installation will be stopped and started again. It takes a few minutes, and the interface will be unavailable meanwhile.
update.waiting: The installation is restarting. The page will reload by itself as soon as the backend responds.
update.timeout: The backend didn't respond in time. See the log: {log}
update.unchanged: The installation stayed on the same version — the update refused to run. See the log: {log}
